text:
Original Disneyland Maps in the Imagineering Art Collection | We Call It Imagineering Bonus Clip
There are so many priceless treasures in the Walt Disney Imagineering Archives and Art Collection like original hand drawn maps and early concepts for Disneyland. Bruce Vaughn, President & Chief Creative Officer, Walt Disney Imagineering, takes a look at some of these items in this We Call It Imagineering Bonus Clip.

📖 Read More on Disney Parks Blog → https://disneyparksblog.com/disney-experiences/go-behind-the-scenes-in-imagineering-video-series/
 
🎥 *About the Series*
Come along as we take you on an inside look at Walt Disney Imagineering. Inspired by how Walt took us along during the development of Disneyland, this new series brings you into the creative and design journey as Disney Imagineers create new, innovative experiences for guests to enjoy at Disney Parks around the world!
